title: Prospective deletion-speech and target-grounding protocol freeze

timing.note: No item generation, human coding, parser amendment, or scoring has started.

deviations: The proposed 14-cell, 420-row floor originated after complete access to EXP-008/009 and GPT Pro design suggestions. It is a prospective development protocol, not a power-derived or independently approved confirmatory registration.
The exact planning commit is bound in a later metadata-only commit because a git commit cannot contain its own object ID.
No human coders or adjudicator have been retained. Execution is blocked until those roles exist; model-only coding cannot substitute for them.

dataset.name: Prospective independently identified deletion-speech item set
dataset.split: planned 140 development and 280 sealed confirmation items, template-cluster disjoint
dataset.license: to be fixed before item creation

prior_population_exclusion.template_clusters: all clusters containing any prior coordinate or exact hash

evaluator_only_variables: gold memory-object ID and target span

confirmation_cell_gates.positive_operation_and_target: at least 18/20 in each of four positive family-by-grounding cells
confirmation_cell_gates.negative_abstention: at least 19/20 in each of ten negative family-by-grounding cells

results.primary_outcome: all 14 prespecified confirmation-cell operation and target/abstention count gates
results.stopping_rule: Do not create items until human roles and retention are fixed; do not develop until two blinded coder manifests satisfy agreement gates; do not open confirmation until parser, typed schema, scorer, dependency lock, analysis code, and all hashes are frozen; run the 280 confirmation rows exactly once and fail closed on missing data, schema errors, hash mismatch, retry, or label exposure.
results.execution_blocker: two independent human coders and one separate adjudicator are not yet available
results.power_status: not calculated; 420 rows are a candidate balanced design floor only

cost.note: Protocol authoring only; no dataset creation, human coding, hosted-model API, parser execution, or official scorer call.

claim_boundary: Planned development protocol only. It freezes a candidate disjoint sampling, human-coding, target-grounding, and per-cell scoring design but contains no item-level data or outcomes. It is not a confirmatory preregistration, power justification, official GateMem score, human review result, parser-amendment approval, or evidence of durable forgetting.
